    Cooling-off period explained

    In short

    Your legal right to change your mind for 14 days after ordering broadband.

    On this page

    1. 01When does the 14 days start
    2. 02What can I do in the cooling-off period
    3. 03What if my service goes live during the 14 days
    4. 04How to cancel within the cooling-off period
    5. 05After the 14 days

    UK law gives you 14 days to cancel a broadband contract without any exit fee.

    When does the 14 days start

    The clock starts the day AFTER you accept the Contract Summary — not the day you order.

    What can I do in the cooling-off period

    Cancel for any reason, no exit fee, no questions.

    What if my service goes live during the 14 days

    • If you asked us to start service within the 14 days: you can still cancel, but you pay for the days of service actually used, plus (in some cases) a proportionate share of any one-off activation costs.
    • If service has not yet gone live: no charge.
    • Your Contract Summary spells this out in your specific case.

    How to cancel within the cooling-off period

    Reply to any OCCTA email, open the chat bubble, or call 0800 260 6626. Tell us "I want to cancel within my cooling-off period." That's enough.

    After the 14 days

    Your normal cancellation notice applies. On rolling plans that's 30 days, no exit fee.
